headline: Indian IT services posted solid top‑line growth, led by Coforge, while profit expansion was mixed.
summary: Revenue grew across the sector, with Coforge posting a 53.6% YoY jump and most peers in the high‑teens. Profit growth varied; HCLTech and Mphasis saw double‑digit profit rises, but Infosys and Wipro reported modest or declining earnings. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys and newly introduced at HCLTech and Wipro. AI‑related revenue and deal wins were highlighted by several firms, underscoring its growing importance.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: AI revenue surged at Infosys (29% YoY), LTM (47% YoY), HCLTech ($219 m) and Mphasis (66% of contracts AI‑led).

themes.title: Margin pressure and guidance changes
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2%; Coforge raised EBIT margin guidance to 16%; HCLTech introduced a modest 2.5‑4% FY27 target.

themes.title: Mixed profit performance
themes.detail: Profit grew double‑digits at HCLTech (21%) and Mphasis (14.6% sequential), but fell at Infosys (6% YoY) and Wipro (‑1.9%).

leaders.why: Revenue up 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance raised to 16%.

laggards.why: Revenue growth only 1.5% YoY and profit margin guidance trimmed.

domain_outlook.note: Mphasis highlighted telecom and device engineering as a growth driver.
